name: Master Vampire

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Burned by Sunlight
traits.details: Whenever the vampire starts its turn in direct sunlight, it takes 10 radiant damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: The vampire regains 10 hit points whenever it starts its turn and has at least 1 hit point. When the vampire takes radiant damage, its regeneration does not function on its next turn.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one dazed, dominated, stunned, or unconscious creature

hit.description: damage, and the vampire regains 20 hit points.

effect.description: The vampire assumes the form of a cloud of bats until the start of its next turn. While in this form, the vampire cannot attack but becomes insubstantial, gains fly 8 (hover), gains a +5 power bonus to Stealth checks, and can move through enemies’ spaces.

powers.name: Dominating Gaze
powers.usageDetails: when no creature is dominated by this power

hit.description: The target is dominated until the end of the vampire’s next turn.

powers.name: Mist Form
powers.trigger: The vampire takes damage while bloodied.

effect.description: The vampire becomes insubstantial and gains fly 12. The vampire cannot attack or use cloud of bats. This effect lasts for 1 hour or until the vampire ends it as a minor action.
